scenario: A width and an alignment are taken by every scalar kind, so on an Int, a String, a Float and a Bool leaf each renders as LGRA.2.9.6.10 states, and no TypeError is raised: `[{p.body.n:>8}|{p.body.s:>8}|{p.body.f:<6}|{p.body.b:>6}]` gives `[       7|      ab|1.5   |  true]`. PATH PINNED: the run-time spec check admitting the kind-free parts on each scalar kind. A check that refused any spec on a Json leaf, or a width on a String or a Bool, would log `type error`.
rules_ds:
schema P scope logical:
    body: Json key

rule r:
    P p
->
    log info "[{p.body.n:>8}|{p.body.s:>8}|{p.body.f:<6}|{p.body.b:>6}]"

rule handler:
    TypeError
->
    log info "type error"
